Fields.Name: Target Map ID
Fields.Description: Distant-view map the row applies to, as a number (m10_00_00_99 → 10000099, overworld m60_00_00_99 → 60000099).

Fields.Name: World State ID
Fields.Description: World state that switches the swap: 300, 310, 311, 312 or 330 (on while the game's world-state list holds it) or 302 (a separate world-state switch). Other values: the row is ignored by the swap. 0: a region row (see the Limited Map Region fields).

Fields.Name: Replacement Source Asset ID
Fields.Description: Single asset hidden while the world state is on and shown while it's off, as AEG number (AEG299_045 → 299045). Used with the source part ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Replacement Source Asset Part ID
Fields.Description: Part number of the source asset (AEG299_045_0000 → 0). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Replacement Destination Asset ID
Fields.Description: Single asset shown while the world state is on and hidden while it's off, as AEG number (AEG299_201 → 299201). Used with the destination part ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Replacement Destination Asset Part ID
Fields.Description: Part number of the destination asset (AEG299_201_0000 → 0). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Replacement Source Asset ID - Min Range
Fields.Description: Start of a range of asset IDs hidden while the world state is on and shown while it's off. -1 (in Min or Max): no range.

Fields.Name: Replacement Source Asset ID - Max Range
Fields.Description: End of the source asset ID range. -1: no range.

Fields.Name: Replacement Destination Asset ID - Min Range
Fields.Description: Start of a range of asset IDs shown while the world state is on and hidden while it's off. -1 (in Min or Max): no range. 999999: no destination range, and the source range is only hidden while the state is on (left alone while it's off).

Fields.Name: Replacement Destination Asset ID - Max Range
Fields.Description: End of the destination asset ID range. -1: no range; 999999: see the Min field.

Fields.Name: Limited Map Region ID [0]
Fields.Description: Region rows (World State ID 0): one of up to four map region IDs the row's asset is limited to.

Fields.Name: Limited Map Region ID [1]
Fields.Description: Region rows (World State ID 0): one of up to four map region IDs the row's asset is limited to.

Fields.Name: Limited Map Region ID [2]
Fields.Description: Region rows (World State ID 0): one of up to four map region IDs the row's asset is limited to.

Fields.Name: Limited Map Region ID [3]
Fields.Description: Region rows (World State ID 0): one of up to four map region IDs the row's asset is limited to.

Fields.Name: Limited Map Region Asset ID
Fields.Description: Region rows (World State ID 0): the asset limited to the map regions above, as AEG number (AEG123_456 → 123456). Used with the part ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Limited Map Region Parts ID
Fields.Description: Region rows: part number of the limited asset (AEG123_456_0000 → 0). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Limited Map Region Asset ID - Range Min
Fields.Description: Region rows: start of a range of asset IDs limited to the map regions above. -1: no range.

Fields.Name: Limited Map Region Asset ID - Range Max
Fields.Description: Region rows: end of the limited asset ID range. -1: no range.
